claims: Assess and manage severe hyperleukocytosis (WBC 116.1 K/uL) with concern for leukostasis, including urgent hematology consultation and cytoreduction evaluation.
Obtain blood cultures and continue broad-spectrum antibiotics (metronidazole, ciprofloxacin) for suspected infection given fever risk and leukocytosis.
Continue intravenous fluid resuscitation and monitor lactate clearance (lactate 3.9 to 3.1 to 3.7 mmol/L) and hemodynamics.
Replete electrolytes: magnesium 1.5 mg/dL and ionized calcium 1.03 mmol/L, with ongoing monitoring of calcium and magnesium.
Manage metabolic acidosis (bicarbonate 15 mEq/L, anion gap 20, base excess -7) with serial ABG/VBG monitoring.
Monitor renal function (creatinine 2.5 mg/dL, BUN 35 mg/dL) with strict intake/output and consider renal ultrasound if not already done.
Continue insulin therapy and glucose monitoring for hyperglycemia (glucose 258 mg/dL, fingersticks 175-238).
Obtain chest imaging (e.g., chest X-ray) to evaluate for pulmonary infiltrates or infection given hypoxia (pO2 36-39 mmHg on venous gas) and respiratory rate 25-32.
Continue stress ulcer prophylaxis and DVT prophylaxis (heparin 5000 units SC) while monitoring coagulation (INR 1.2, PTT 29.1).
Maintain fall precautions and bed rest with assistance for mobility given high fall risk and bedfast status.
